# Xen'Kara
Xen'Kara - as they call themselves - are a divergent, modified species related to the Xeno hives. They retain their ancestral hunger, and resistance to acids, at the cost of being more vulnerable to electric shocks.
Born from a single Queen Mother, their weakened hivemind makes them naturally democratic, and they are highly social, frequently gathering to elect a local leader.
While they can likely get much older, there is no individual older than 200 years - the time of the First Queen.
## The Hunger
[color=#999999][italic]"Yummy!"[/italic][/color]
While Xen'Kara are able to store significant reserves of nutrients in their bodies, they also burn through them at alarming rates. A starving Xen'Kara becomes downright ravenous, and may devour enough food to feed four people in one sitting.
Botanists, kitchen staff and engineers are of particular cultural significance to Xen'Kara individuals, as they are the ones keeping the Hivehome fed and breathing.
## Ancestral Strains
Xen'Kara exhibit a variety of traits, lying dormant within their biology until activated. Each of these comes with a significant metabolic cost, but can allow them to spit acid, leap at foes, heal others or even build their own structures.
## The Congress
Groups of Xen'Kara individuals will designate one of their own as a Voice of the Queen, charged with organising what remains of their hivemind and acting as a go-between with the Queen-Mother. This process is democratic in nature; the position is treated as both an honour and a burden.
## Racial Features - Take [color=#00aa00]10% less[/color] caustic damage. - Common acids [color=#00aa00]do not hurt[/color]. - [color=#FFA500]Your blood is acid[/color]. - Take [color=#aa0000]30% more[/color] shock damage. - Your exoskeleton and acid blood [color=#aa0000]prevent basic topicals from working[/color] on you.
- You get hungry [color=#aa0000]very quickly[/color]. - You [color=#00aa00]do not get slowed[/color] when starving. - You can [color=#FFA500]store extra nutrients[/color], so eating a lot will keep you sated for longer. - You can [color=#00aa00]eat almost anything[/color], including rotten food. - You may [color=#00aa00]spend hunger to fuel abilities[/color].
- Your tail is sharp and pointy. You may [color=#00aa00]use it as a spear[/color]. - You can [color=#FFA500]talk to wild xenos[/color], but they remain hostile. - You [color=#aa0000]deal damage when thrown[/color], whether from being spiky or reflexive biting.
